clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for dimensions, physical properties and workmanship of rectangular blocks made from laterite stone, used in the construction of walls and partitions.

clauses.title: General Requirements
clauses.text: 2. General Requirements — Shall be exposed for three months before using but not to rains. Shall be without any soft veins, cracks, cavities, flaws and similar imperfections.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions — Length Breadth Thickness mm mm mm 390 190 190 490 190 190 590 290 290

clauses.title: Physical Properties
clauses.text: 4. Physical Properties — See Table 1. TABLE 1 PHYSICAL PROPERTIES SI. Characteristic Requirement No. (1) (2) (3) i) Water absorption Not more than 12 percent by mass ii) Specific gravity Not less than 2.5 iii) Compressive strength Not Less than (for saturated dry samples) 3.5N/mm2

clauses.title: Workmanship
clauses.text: 5. Workmanship —  Blocks shall be of uniform shape with straight edges at right angles and edges be rough and chisel dressed. SUMMARY OF IS 3620 : 1979 LATERITE  STONE  BLOCK  FOR  MASONRY (First Revision) Note — For methods of tests, refer to IS 1121(Part 1) : 1974 Methods of test for determination of strength properties of natural building stones : Part 1 Compressive strength (first revision) and IS 1124:1974 Method of test for determination of water absorption, apparent specific gravity and porosity of natural building stones (first revision). For detailed information, refer to IS 3620:1979 Specifications for laterite stone block for mansonry (first revision).
